state: Note from the block manager, 14 June. Residents of flats 5 and 7 have complained about flat 6, which the owner, Mr. Lyle, lets out for short stays. The complaints are: loud music after 23:00 on 30 May, 6 June and 13 June; a guest's suitcase left blocking the fire exit on 13 June; and bin bags left in the hallway twice. The building rules say there must be no noise audible in other flats between 23:00 and 07:00, and nothing may be left in corridors or fire exits at any time. The head lease does not allow any letting of a flat for less than 90 nights at a time. Mr. Lyle's booking page shows stays of 2 to 4 nights. He says he did not know about the 90-night rule and that his guests are "mostly quiet". The block manager can send a written warning herself at no cost; the freeholder's solicitor charges GBP 450 to send a formal breach letter. Nothing has been sent to Mr. Lyle so far.
